page: Amazon Web Services i8ge.metal-48xl is a storage-optimized bare metal server powered by 192 dedicated physical cores of the AWS Graviton ARMv9 Neoverse-V2 architecture running at 2.7 GHz. This arm64 platform features 1536.0 GB of DDR5 memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core, and is equipped with a massive 120,000 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 300 Gbps, with no integrated GPUs.

Benchmark results position this instance in the top tier for multi-core CPU performance, memory bandwidth, and database operations. It achieves top-tier performance in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, Geekbench software compilation, and Redis SET operations, which reached 378.59 million operations per second. However, single-core performance remains in the average tier, as demonstrated by stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores, and text generation for small LLM models is rated in the bottom tier.

Given its bare-metal architecture, high-density DDR5 memory, and substantial 120 TB local NVMe storage, the server offers high qualitative resource density for data-intensive environments. The lack of hyperthreading ensures predictable, dedicated compute performance. This hardware profile is highly suited for large-scale databases, high-throughput static web serving, data warehousing, and intensive multi-threaded processing workloads.
